capabilities: Browse Zhihu recommendations, following, hot list, and recent feeds in a sidebar
Read answers, articles, and pins in a dedicated reader tab
Save content as Markdown and update existing files while keeping frontmatter
Import single posts by link or batch import with retries
Refresh existing Zhihu Markdown to sync the latest content
extras: Requires Obsidian desktop 1.13.0+ and the Web viewer core plugin. Login cookies are stored in plain text in the plugin's data file, which the README warns to keep out of Git and untrusted sync.
problem: Zhihu content cannot be read or turned into Markdown notes from inside Obsidian without switching to the website and copying text manually.

relations.evidence: This project was inspired by zimya/zhihu_obsidian (Zhihu on Obsidian).

summary: Sidebar client for Zhihu that browses feeds and profiles and saves questions, answers, articles, and pins as Markdown notes.
